scripts.build: npm run build -w @trefood/shared && npm run build -w @trefood/backend && npm run build -w @trefood/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @trefood/shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @trefood/backend" "npm run dev -w @trefood/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @trefood/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @trefood/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
